events.title: Shuzenji Temple
events.description: Zen temple said to be founded by Kūkai in 807, centerpiece of the onsen town.

events.title: Chikurin-no-Komichi (Bamboo Path)

events.title: Tokko-no-Yu Footbath
events.description: Symbolic hot-spring source in the riverbed (view only, no bathing).
